PSA 46:1.KJV: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
PSA 46:1.BHSA: אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָרֹ֗ות נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃

PSA 46:2.KJV: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
PSA 46:2.BHSA: עַל־כֵּ֣ן לֹא־נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמֹ֥וט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃

PSA 46:3.KJV: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
PSA 46:3.BHSA: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָתֹ֣ו סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 46:4.KJV: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
PSA 46:4.BHSA: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֹֽון׃

PSA 46:5.KJV: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
PSA 46:5.BHSA: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמֹּ֑וט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנֹ֥ות בֹּֽקֶר׃

PSA 46:6.KJV: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
PSA 46:6.BHSA: הָמ֣וּ גֹ֖ויִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכֹ֑ות נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קֹולֹ֗ו תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 46:7.KJV: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
PSA 46:7.BHSA: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאֹ֣ות עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 46:8.KJV: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
PSA 46:8.BHSA: לְֽכוּ־חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲלֹ֣ות יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖ם שַׁמֹּ֣ות בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 46:9.KJV: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
PSA 46:9.BHSA: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמֹות֮ עַד־קְצֵ֢ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָלֹ֗ות יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

PSA 46:10.KJV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
PSA 46:10.BHSA: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גֹּויִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 46:11.KJV: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
PSA 46:11.BHSA: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאֹ֣ות עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
